$Comment: Old Jack buys back a spare Horseman's Reins. One pair calls the Horseman's Steed, and a player's Tamework roster holds only one steed, so a second pair from the Horseman's Boss Kill Claim does nothing; this turns it into Hallow Sweets, the way Hallows_Eve_Offer_Sell_Eternal_Candle.json takes a spare Eternal Candle. The player hands in one pair (Cost.Items, taken from the bag, storage or hotbar like any item price on this shop) and gets the sweets in Rewards, a Currency row paid straight into their Hallow Sweets wallet; change Amount to change what he pays. The Reins drop only where Alec's Tamework runs, so Requires carries its hytale:mod_installed gate at the top level, Min 1: on a server without it the library leaves this file out at load (one drop line for the ShopEntries store) and the offer never shows. Icon shows the Reins on the shelf rather than the wallet's own picture. No purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 65 puts it last on the gear shelf. Selling your only pair loses the way to call your steed, so the title and flavor call it a spare.
